_doc: Training provenance of every checkpoint scripts/make_release.py may put in a release (read by that script).
A run is keyed by its path relative to checkpoints/ (the directory holding the .pt, or the .pt itself for a
loose file). 'data' names datasets below, 'init' the run(s) whose weights it started from (a merge lists
several). make_release walks the whole init chain and refuses any run that is unknown here or whose chain
touches a source with allowed=false. Add an entry for every new training run you want to ship, with the

data-v2.how: land = GEDTM30 (GLO-30 only where GEDTM30 has no value: water surfaces, build_v2._tile_job); sea floor = GEBCO 2024 (topobathy); hawaii + puerto_rico sea floors refined with NOAA CUDEM (refloor_v2 --cudem, 2026-11-18 18:45); cells_climate.npz = data/climate_hybrid (CHELSA v2.1 at 30" + ERA5 u10/v10/soil/lsm/orog from the WeatherBench 2 climatology); drainage weighted by that precipitation (finish_v2); water.npz (banks) and carve labels derived from the DEM. No WorldClim anywhere (build.py, the v1 builder, is the only WorldClim reader and is not used).

climate-025.how: train_climate inputs: GEBCO 2024 block means on the 0.25 deg ERA5 grid; ERA5 10 m wind (WB2); targets: CHELSA v2.1 block means + ERA5 soil/snow (climate_hybrid). Paleo planets only with --paleo.

data-v1.how: GLO-30 surface model + WorldClim 2.1 bio1/4/12/15 climate in cells.npz (t0, tseason, precip, pcv) and WorldClim-precipitation-weighted drainage (acc, rivers). Also the DEFAULT --data-dir of train_detail / train_qad / train_biomes (/mnt/extrastorage/terrain-slm-data globs only the v1 regions).

v2-15m-lidar.path: /mnt/extrastorage/terrain-slm-data/v2-15m-lidar (90 regions: v2-15m's 21 USGS tiles (symlinks), 12 new USGS 1/3" tiles (raw/3dep13_v2), 57 lidar boxes of 20-32 km (raw/<source>/sr10))
v2-15m-lidar.how: scripts/download_lidar.py: each provider's DTM area-averaged to 10 m in its own CRS (COG overviews + Resampling.average, or 5 m / 2 m service data block-averaged); data/build_15m.py --lidar: 10 m -> 15 m with the 3DEP step (Gaussian 0.5(1/f-1) px + bilinear). Per-file URLs: raw/<source>/PROVENANCE.jsonl; licences: raw/<source>/LICENCE.json. Whole boxes held out (role val).

v2-surface.how: data/surface_labels.py: 0.5-1 m DTM windows -> 15 m / 60 m labels (rock, scree, smooth, roughness, boulders) + 60 m block means as inputs; climate inputs = CHELSA v2.1 bio1 / bio12 at the window centre (temperature lapse-adjusted per cell).

v2-vegetation.path: /mnt/extrastorage/terrain-slm-data/v2-gedtm30/<region>/veg60.npy + veg_cc30.npy (data/vegetation.py) and the crop set /mnt/extrastorage/terrain-slm-data/veg_dataset (train/train_veg.py build)
v2-vegetation.how: targets = ETH canopy height 2020 + ESA WorldCover 2021 10 m pixels binned into each data-v2 region's 60 m grid (raw tiles + sha256 in raw/vegetation_manifest.json); inputs = the data-v2 DEM (block-quantised), data-v2 climate cells (CHELSA v2.1 + ERA5), sea.npy + water.npz. No WorldClim.
